G1 / MAIN DISPLAY MENU

Personal Hub

One button opens the menu. Track buttons move through your apps. Pause again to open the selection. Select Close menu at the top to dismiss it.

Controls

Pause: open menu, then select.
Next / fast-forward: next option.
Previous / rewind: previous option.
Automatic play/resume: no menu action.
G1 tap: next. Double tap: select. Hold: return to menu.

Volume buttons still adjust phone volume. This WebView has no supported volume-button event.

App setup

Teleprompter opens its actual app screen and uses its own scripts.

Notes displays existing notes. Track buttons browse them; Pause returns to the menu. Merge uses its normal background startup.

Device test

Silent audio keeps media controls active while this phone UI remains alive. Keep this phone screen open. Apps run in the background; Pause stops the selected app and returns to the menu. Hosted installs download app files to your phone; app-launch privileges depend on your Mentra version. Apps must already be installed. Current Mentra iPhone/G1 versions may not supply phone notification events; launching Notify cannot create missing events.
